verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a public, URL-versioned REST API (api.airbyte.com/v1) for programmatic control. It has token-based access, a published OpenAPI spec in the official airbytehq GitHub org, and a ReadMe reference with a live Try It console. Migration guides cover breaking changes. The 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives elsewhere (GitHub), not that the API is missing. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the API, a formal version-lifecycle/sunset policy

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.
Most programmatic interactions with Airbyte require an access token.
Programmatically control Airbyte Cloud, OSS & Enterprise.
Airbyte publishes migration guides to assist with any breaking changes to our API users.
